title: Kusanagi Nene — Gentle Encouragement From Afar〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: One Small Trip Before a Big Journey

rows.Line: Shibuya Park

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So the next scene is when the canary and Rio meet... Okay, I'll practice this.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's important to show what kind of character the canary is here, so I've got to do this right.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (And then this is when Rio is lured by the canary's singing and comes over...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
“H-Huh?!
Who's there...?!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “N-No, stay away...!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Maybe it should sound a little stronger.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “N-No, stay away...!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
“Oh... I-I'm sorry...
But please... Go somewhere else...”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
“I don't like humans...
Because they're always mean to me...”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: *Exhale*

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I managed to get it pretty much exactly how I wanted. This should be...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Wait, no. I can't be satisfied with this.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I need to be more immersed in the canary's character. I can do better...!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, look at the time...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Hoshino should be coming soon. I think I'll rest my voice for a bit.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I haven't seen her since her solo show.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Her singing and performance just keep improving. I feel like I'm the one learning from her.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'd better keep up.
Kusanagi!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, Hoshino.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You're here so early. Have you started practicing already?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Just a little bit of acting. I haven't started singing practice yet.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right. You did mention that the 30th Anniversary Show is soon. Thank you for coming even though you're so busy.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's okay. I was looking forward to practicing with you anyway.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Also, you went to Yokohama with your class for a field trip, right? How was it?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It was super fun. My group and I ate some really nice curry, went shopping at the Red Brick Center, and...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Well, some things happened and my friend and I went on the water taxi.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe, I see. I heard the weather was good that day too, so that must've been nice.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It was. Oh, Honami and Otori were in the same group and said that they went around Chinatown.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I heard about that too. Emu told me all about it. Seemed like they had a lot of fun.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: She came back with both arms full of souvenirs and was giving them all out to the other cast members.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I even got some cheesecake, chocolates and a lot of other stuff...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I actually have a souvenir for you too, Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Um, it's a keychain...
Here...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wow... It's a little blue bird. It's so cute...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Do you remember the musical you recommended to me a while ago? I somewhat remembered that the main character treasured something like this...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I did think about getting something more Yokohama-ish, but...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Well... I thought something that could remind you that I'm cheering you on would be better.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hoshino...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank you. I love it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Also... I actually got a matching one. See...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I asked a friend what would be a good souvenir that could be a sign of my support.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And she suggested having matching items...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: She said that a reminder that you're not alone might help you have courage when you're feeling anxious.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (That I'm not alone...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank you for putting so much thought into it, Hoshino.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Can I...put it on my bag? I want it to always be with me.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Of course.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Done!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I've said it before, but... I'll be cheering for you, Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay then, shall we start practicing?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sounds good.
